title: Fixlinx launches global fastener catalog
excerpt: The Fixlinx product catalog is now available for download, covering wood, structural, decking and self-drilling fasteners plus retail packaging formats.
body: Fixlinx Industrial has released a new product catalog that brings together our full range of fasteners and retail packaging solutions in a single document.
The catalog covers wood screws, structural timber screws, decking screws, self-drilling and self-tapping fasteners, plus our retail packaging formats including tubs, blisters, carded packs and boxes.
The catalog is available for download from the DOWNLOAD section of this website, and can also be requested directly from our sales team.
